156size_t fill_vertex_buffer_mesh(Mesh * mesh, MainVertex * verts, size_t offset, size_t * lm_offset)
157{
158 MeshFace * tris = (MeshFace *)mesh->tris.buffer;
159 Point * pts = (Point*)mesh->vertices.buffer;
160
161 size_t current_lm_offset = *lm_offset;
162 size_t count = 0;
163 if (mesh->static_mesh)
164 {
165
166 LightmapData * ld = &GLOBALS.scene_data.lightmap_data;
167 UVIsland * islands = CAST_VEC(ld->islands, UVIsland);
168 MeshNode * mns = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.mesh_nodes, MeshNode);
169 int current_offset = offset;
170 current_lm_offset = current_offset;
171 SubMesh * sms = CAST_VEC(mesh->submeshes, SubMesh);
172
173 for (int j = 0; j < mesh->submeshes.count; j++)
174 {
175 SubMesh * sm = &sms[j];
176 sm->draw_offset = current_offset;
177
178 int current_count = 0;
179 sm->lm_offset = current_offset;
180
181 for (int k = 0; k < sm->index_count / 3; k++)
182 {
183 size_t idx = k + sm->first_index / 3;
184 MeshFace * tri = &tris[idx];
185 TriangleAdjacency * tri_adj = mesh->tri_adjacency;
186
187 for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++)
188 {
189
190 int index = tri->indices[p];
191
192 verts[current_offset].pos = pts[index].pos;
193 verts[current_offset].normal = pts[index].normal;
194 verts[current_offset].tangent = pts[index].tangent;
195 verts[current_offset].joint_indices = pts[index].joints;
196 verts[current_offset].weights = pts[index].weights;
197 verts[current_offset].uv = pts[index].uv;
198 count++;
199 current_count++;
200 current_offset++;
201 }
202 }
203 if (!islands) continue;
204 int mesh_count = 0;
205 for (int i = 0; i < GLOBALS.mesh_nodes.count; i++)
206 {
207
208 if (mns[i].mesh != mesh->id || mns[i].free || !mns[i].uv_map) continue;
209
210 MeshNode * mn = &mns[i];
211 UVMapping * uv_map = mn->uv_map;
212
213
214 for (int k = 0; k < sm->index_count / 3; k++)
215 {
216
217 size_t idx = k + sm->first_index / 3;
218 MeshFace * tri = &tris[idx];
219 TriangleAdjacency * tri_adj = mesh->tri_adjacency;
220
221 if (uv_map)
222 {
223
224 UVIsland * uvi = &islands[uv_map[idx].uv_island];
225 LightmapUV * uv = &uvi->uvs[uv_map[idx].uv_idx];
226
227 for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++)
228 {
229
230 LIGHTMAP_DATA.uvs[current_lm_offset + idx * 3 + p + mesh_count * sm->index_count].uv = (vec4){(*uv[p]).x, (*uv[p]).y, 0, 0};
231 }
232
233 }
234 }
235 mesh_count++;
236 }
237
238 }
239 }
240 else
241 {
242
243 for (int j = 0; j < mesh->vertices.count; j++)
244 {
245 verts[offset + j].pos = pts[j].pos;
246 verts[offset + j].normal = pts[j].normal;
247 verts[offset + j].tangent = pts[j].tangent;
248 verts[offset + j].joint_indices = pts[j].joints;
249 verts[offset + j].weights = pts[j].weights;
250 verts[offset + j].uv = pts[j].uv;
251
252 count++;
253 }
254 }
255
256 return count;
257}

343void add_mesh_to_buffer(Mesh * m, VertexLayout * layout)
344{
345
346 size_t * mesh_id = vector_expand(&layout->meshes, 1);
347 *mesh_id = m->id;
348
349 vsize = calc_mesh_size(m);
350 visize = calc_mesh_index_size(m);
351 glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, layout->vbo);
352
353 layout->current_offset = 0;
354 layout->current_index_offset = 0;
355 size_t * ms = CAST_VEC(layout->meshes, size_t);
356 Mesh * meshes = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.meshes, Mesh);
357 vsize = 0;
358 visize = 0;
359 for (int i = 0; i < layout->meshes.count; i++)
360 {
361 Mesh * m = &meshes[ms[i]];
362 vsize += calc_mesh_size(m);
363 visize += calc_mesh_index_size(m);
364 }
365 layout->current_capacity = vsize * 2;
366 layout->current_index_capacity = visize * 2;
367
368 glBufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, layout->current_capacity, NULL, GL_DYNAMIC_DRAW);
369 MainVertex * verts = malloc(vsize);
370 uint32_t * indices = NULL;
371 if (visize)
372 {
373 indices = malloc(visize);
374 }
375
376 size_t offset = 0;
377 size_t index_offset = 0;
378 size_t lm_offset = 0;
379
380 for (int i = 0; i < layout->meshes.count; i++)
381 {
382 Mesh * m = &meshes[ms[i]];
383 m->offset = index_offset;
384 size_t current_offset = fill_vertex_buffer_mesh(m, verts, offset, &lm_offset);
385 index_offset += fill_index_buffer_mesh(m, indices, offset, index_offset, &lm_offset);
386 m->count = m->tris.count * 3;
387 offset += current_offset;
388 }
389
390
391 glBufferSubData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, vsize, verts);
392 if (indices)
393 {
394 glBindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, layout->ebo);
395 glBufferData(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, visize, indices, GL_DYNAMIC_DRAW);
396 }
397 layout->current_offset = vsize;
398 layout->current_index_offset = visize;
399
400 free(verts);
401 if (indices) free(indices);
402
403
404}

602void copy_light_to_gpu_light(LightGPU * lgpu, Light * l)
603{
604
605 lgpu->dir = l->dir;
606 lgpu->pos= l->pos;
607 lgpu->entity_id= l->entity_id;
608 lgpu->dir= l->dir;
609 lgpu->rgb= l->rgb;
610 lgpu->intensity= l->intensity;
611 lgpu->light_type= l->light_type;
612
613
614 l->outer_angle = l->cone_angle * 0.5f;
615 l->inner_angle = l->outer_angle * (1 - l->penumbra);
616
617 lgpu->inner_angle= l->inner_angle;
618 lgpu->outer_angle= l->outer_angle;
619
620 float outer_cos = cosf(l->outer_angle);
621 float cos_diff = cosf(l->inner_angle) - outer_cos;
622 lgpu->outer_cos = outer_cos;
623 lgpu->cos_diff = 1.0f/cos_diff;
624
625 l->radius = sqrtf(l->intensity / l->threshold);
626 lgpu->radius = l->radius;
627 lgpu->layer = l->layer;
628 lgpu->mesh = l->mesh;
629 lgpu->tri = l->tri;
630 lgpu->area = l->surface_area;
631
632}

665
666 int offset = 0;
667
668
669 for (int i = 0; i < GLOBALS.mesh_nodes.count; i++)
670 {
671
672 MeshNode * mn = &mns[i];
673 if (mn->mesh == -1 || mn->free) continue;
674
675 Mesh * m = &meshes[mn->mesh];
676
677 float closest[3][MAX_LIGHTS_PER_MESH] = {0.0f};
678 int closest_counts[3] = {0};
679 int closest_indices[3][MAX_LIGHTS_PER_MESH] = {0};
680 int total_count = 0;
681
682 for (int j = 0; j < GLOBALS.lights.count; j++)
683 {
684
685 Light * l = &lights[j];
686 if (l->light_type == POINT_LIGHT) continue;
687
688 vec3 dist = vec3_sub(l->pos, mn->translation);
689 float d2 = vec3_length(dist);
690 d2 *= d2;
691 LightType type = l->light_type;
692 if (type != DIRECTIONAL_LIGHT && l->intensity / d2 < MINIMUM_LIGHT_VISIBILITY_DIST) continue;
693 // cap directional light at 1
694 if (type == DIRECTIONAL_LIGHT)
695 {
696 if (closest_counts[DIRECTIONAL_LIGHT] >= MAX_DIRECTIONAL_LIGHTS) continue;
697 d2 = -INFINITY;
698 }
699
700 if (total_count >= MAX_LIGHTS_PER_MESH)
701 {
702 float highest_val = -INFINITY;
703 int highest_index = -1;
704 for (int k = 0; k < closest_counts[type]; k++)
705 {
706 if (closest[type][k] > highest_val)
707 {
708 highest_val = closest[type][k];
709 highest_index = k;
710 }
711 }
712 if (highest_val < d2)
713 {
714 closest_indices[type][highest_index] = j;
715 closest[type][highest_index] = d2;
716 }
717
718 }
719 else
720 {
721 closest_indices[type][closest_counts[type]] = j;
722 closest[type][closest_counts[type]++] = d2;
723 total_count++;
724 }
725
726 }
727
728 mn->point_light_offset = offset;
729 mn->point_light_count = closest_counts[POINT_LIGHT];
730 mn->directional_light_offset = offset + closest_counts[POINT_LIGHT];
731 mn->directional_light_count = closest_counts[DIRECTIONAL_LIGHT];
732 mn->spot_light_offset = offset + closest_counts[POINT_LIGHT] + closest_counts[DIRECTIONAL_LIGHT];
733 mn->spot_light_count = closest_counts[SPOT_LIGHT];
734
735 int current_offset = 0;
736 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
737 {
738
739 for (int j = 0; j < closest_counts[i]; j++)
740 {
741 GLOBALS.mesh_light_indices[offset+current_offset] = closest_indices[i][j];
742 current_offset++;
743 }
744 }
745
746 offset += total_count;
747
748 }
749
750 size_t mesh_light_offset = current_frame * mesh_light_ssbo_size;
751
752 uint32_t * mesh_light_data = (uint32_t*)(mesh_light_ssbo_ptr + mesh_light_offset);
753 memcpy(mesh_light_data, GLOBALS.mesh_light_indices, sizeof(uint32_t) * offset);
754 glBindBufferRange(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER, 1, MESH_LIGHT_SSBO, mesh_light_offset, mesh_light_ssbo_size);
755
756
757
758}

939// unused old frustum culling code
940void
941 get_view_planes
942 (
943 vec4 planes[6],
944 Camera * cam
945 )
946
947{
948
949
950
951 mat4 VP = m4_mul(cam->cam_data.proj, cam->cam_data.view);
952
953 vec4 r0 = (vec4){VP.a0, VP.b0, VP.c0, VP.d0};
954 vec4 r1 = (vec4){VP.a1, VP.b1, VP.c1, VP.d1};
955 vec4 r2 = (vec4){VP.a2, VP.b2, VP.c2, VP.d2};
956 vec4 r3 = (vec4){VP.a3, VP.b3, VP.c3, VP.d3};
957 planes[0] = vec4_add(r3, r0);
958 planes[1] = vec4_sub(r3, r0);
959 planes[2] = vec4_add(r3, r1);
960 planes[3] = vec4_sub(r3, r1);
961 planes[4] = vec4_add(r3, r2);
962 planes[5] = vec4_sub(r3, r2);
963
964 for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
965 float length = sqrtf(planes[i].x * planes[i].x + planes[i].y * planes[i].y + planes[i].z * planes[i].z);
966
967
968 if (length > 0.00001f) {
969 float inv_len = 1.0f / length;
970 planes[i].x *= inv_len;
971 planes[i].y *= inv_len;
972 planes[i].z *= inv_len;
973 planes[i].w *= inv_len;
974 }
975
976 }
977
978}

981
982bool
983 aabb_in_frustum
984 (
985 vec3 min,
986 vec3 max,
987 vec4 planes[6]
988 )
989
990{
991 for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
992 {
993 vec3 p = {
994 planes[i].x >= 0.0f ? max.x : min.x,
995 planes[i].y >= 0.0f ? max.y : min.y,
996 planes[i].z >= 0.0f ? max.z : min.z
997 };
998
999 if (vec3_dot((vec3){planes[i].x, planes[i].y, planes[i].z}, p) + planes[i].w < 0.0f)
1000 {
1001 return false;
1002 }
1003 }
1004
1005 return true;
1006}

1033void populate_draw_commands(DrawCommand * dcs, int * draw_command_cnt)

1035
1036 Mesh * meshes = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.meshes, Mesh);
1037 MeshNode * mns = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.mesh_nodes, MeshNode);
1038 *draw_command_cnt = 0;

1040
1041 GLTFSkin * skins = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.skins, GLTFSkin);
1042

1045
1046 MeshNode * mn = &mns[i];
1047 if (mn->mesh == -1 || mn->free) continue;

1049 Mesh * m = &meshes[mn->mesh];
1050 SubMesh * sms = CAST_VEC(m->submeshes, SubMesh);

1053 {
1054
1055 DrawCommand * dc = &dcs[*draw_command_cnt];

1057 if (sms[j].material == -1)
1058 {
1059 dc->material = 0;

1061 else
1062 {
1063
1064 dc->material = sms[j].material;
1065 }
1066
1067 dc->start_index = sms[j].draw_offset;
1068 dc->fwd_shader = mats[dc->material].fwd_shader;
1069 dc->gbuffer_shader = mats[dc->material].gbuffer_shader;
1070 dc->index_count = sms[j].index_count;
1071 dc->lm_offset = sms[j].lm_offset;
1072 dc->matrix = mn->global_matrix;
1073 dc->static_mesh = m->static_mesh;
1074 dc->mesh_id = m->id;
1075 dc->point_light_count = mn->point_light_count;
1076 dc->point_light_offset = mn->point_light_offset;
1077 dc->directional_light_count = mn->directional_light_count;
1078 dc->directional_light_offset = mn->directional_light_offset;
1079 dc->spot_light_count = mn->spot_light_count;
1080 dc->spot_light_offset = mn->spot_light_offset;
1081 dc->sm_id = j;
1082 dc->mn_id = mn->id;
1083
1084
1085 if (mn->skin != -1)
1086 {
1087 dc->skin_offset = skins[mn->skin].ssbo_offset;
1088 }
1089 else
1090 {
1091 dc->skin_offset = 0;
1092 }
1093 if (mats[dc->material].override_transparent)
1094 {
1095 dc->opaque = 0;
1096 }
1097 else
1098 {
1099
1100 dc->opaque = (uint8_t)(mats[dc->material].kd.w * 255);
1101 }
1102
1103
1104 dc->sort_key = 0;
1105
1106 dc->sort_key |= ((uint64_t)(dc->opaque) << 56ULL);
1107 dc->sort_key |= ((uint64_t)(dc->mesh_id) << 40ULL);
1108 dc->sort_key |= ((uint64_t)(dc->material) << 24ULL);
1109 dc->sort_key |= ((uint64_t)(dc->static_mesh) << 16ULL);
1110 dc->sort_key |= ((uint64_t)(dc->fwd_shader) << 0ULL);
1111
1112 (*draw_command_cnt)++;
1113
1114 }
1115
1116 }
1117
1118}

1154void add_text_box(Vector * tvs, Vector * tis, TextBox * tb, int current_box)
1155{
1156
1157 if (tb->text == NULL) return;
1158 int len = strlen(tb->text);
1159
1160 float x = tb->start.x, y = tb->start.y;
1161 float scale = tb->text_size;
1162 Font * fonts = CAST_VEC(FONTS, Font);
1163 Font * f = &fonts[tb->font_id];
1164
1165 float max_x = 0;
1166 float max_y = 0;
1167 Glyph * glyphs = f->glyphs;
1168
1169 for (int i = 0; i < len; i++){
1170 char ch = tb->text[i];
1171
1172 Glyph *g = NULL;
1173 for (int j = 0; j < f->glyph_count; j++) {
1174 if (glyphs[j].id == ch) {
1175 g = &glyphs[j];
1176 break;
1177 }
1178 }
1179 if (!g) continue;
1180
1181 float x0 = x + g->xoffset * scale;
1182 float y0 = (y - 7 * scale) + g->yoffset * scale;
1183 float x1 = x0 + g->width * scale;
1184 float y1 = y0 + g->height * scale;
1185 float u0 = g->u0;
1186 float v0 = g->v0;
1187 float u1 = g->u1;
1188 float v1 = g->v1;
1189 vec2 center = (vec2){(x1-x0) / 2 + x0, (y1-y0)/2 + y0};
1190
1191 TextVertex * v = vector_expand(tvs, 4);
1192
1193 uint32_t * idx = vector_expand(tis, 6);
1194
1195 v[0] = (TextVertex){.pos = (vec2){x0, y0}, .uv = (vec2){u0, v0}, .center = center, .color = tb->color, .fill = tb->fill, .state = 0, .uID = current_box};
1196
1197 v[1] = (TextVertex){.pos = (vec2){x1, y0}, .uv = (vec2){u1, v0}, .center = center, .color = tb->color, .fill = tb->fill, .state = 0, .uID = current_box};
1198
1199 v[2] = (TextVertex){.pos = (vec2){x0, y1}, .uv = (vec2){u0, v1}, .center = center, .color = tb->color, .fill = tb->fill, .state = 0, .uID = current_box};
1200
1201 v[3] = (TextVertex){.pos = (vec2){x1, y1}, .uv = (vec2){u1, v1}, .center = center, .color = tb->color, .fill = tb->fill, .state = 0, .uID = current_box};
1202
1203 uint32_t i0 = tvs->count-4;
1204 uint32_t i1 = tvs->count-3;
1205 uint32_t i2 = tvs->count-2;
1206 uint32_t i3 = tvs->count-1;
1207
1208 idx[0] = i0;
1209 idx[1] = i1;
1210 idx[2] = i2;
1211 idx[3] = i2;
1212 idx[4] = i1;
1213 idx[5] = i3;
1214
1215
1216 x += g->xadvance * scale;
1217
1218 }
1219}
1220void add_all_text_boxes_to_draw_buffer()
1221{
1222 TEXT_INDEX_COUNT = 0;
1223 Vector tvs;
1224 init_vector(&tvs, 0, sizeof(TextVertex));
1225
1226 Vector tis;
1227 init_vector(&tis, 0, sizeof(uint32_t));
1228
1229 UIMenu * ms = CAST_VEC(MENUS, UIMenu);
1230 int current_box = 0;
1231 for (int i = 0; i < MENUS.count; i++)
1232 {
1233
1234 UIMenu * m = &ms[i];
1235 TextBox * tbs = m->text_boxes;
1236
1237 for (int j = 0; j < MAX_TEXT_BOXES; j++)
1238 {
1239 if (tbs[j].free) continue;
1240 add_text_box(&tvs, &tis, &tbs[j], current_box);
1241 current_box++;

1244 }

1247 glBufferSubData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, sizeof(TextVertex) * tvs.count, tvs.buffer);

1253
1254 if (tvs.buffer) free(tvs.buffer);
1255 if (tis.buffer) free(tis.buffer);
1256
1257}

1260void GPU_upload_singular_text_box(UIContainer * cs, TextBox * tb, int * TC)
1261{
1262
1263 int tb_count = *TC;
1264 float scale_x = (float)TEXT_WIDTH / UI_SCALE_WIDTH;
1265 float scale_y = (float)TEXT_HEIGHT / UI_SCALE_HEIGHT;
1266 float screen_scale_x = (float)SCREEN_WIDTH / UI_SCALE_WIDTH;
1267 float screen_scale_y = (float)SCREEN_HEIGHT / UI_SCALE_HEIGHT;
1268 vec2 text_tr = tb->translation;
1269 text_tr.x *= scale_x;
1270 text_tr.y *= scale_y;
1271 vec2 scale = tb->scale;
1272 mat4 mat = compose_2d_transform(text_tr, tb->angle, scale);
1273 uint32_t visible = tb->visible;
1274
1275 float scale_screen = compute_ui_scale(UI_SCALE_WIDTH, UI_SCALE_HEIGHT, SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT);
1276 vec2 tr = tb->translation;
1277 tr.x *= screen_scale_x;
1278 tr.y *= screen_scale_y;
1279 vec2 tr_scale = tb->scale;
1280 tr_scale.x *= screen_scale_x;
1281 tr_scale.y *= screen_scale_y;
1282 mat4 mat_screen = compose_2d_transform(tr, tb->angle, tr_scale);
1283 uint32_t hovered = 0;
1284
1285 float w = tb->w;
1286 float h = tb->h;
1287 vec2 p0 = (vec2){-w/2, -h/2};
1288 vec2 p1 = (vec2){w/2, -h/2};
1289 vec2 p2 = (vec2){-w/2, h/2};
1290 vec2 p3 = (vec2){w/2, h/2};
1291 vec3 pos0 = mat4_mul_point(mat_screen, (vec3){p0.x, p0.y, 0.0});
1292 vec3 pos1 = mat4_mul_point(mat_screen, (vec3){p1.x, p1.y, 0.0});
1293 vec3 pos2 = mat4_mul_point(mat_screen, (vec3){p2.x, p2.y, 0.0});
1294 vec3 pos3 = mat4_mul_point(mat_screen, (vec3){p3.x, p3.y, 0.0});
1295 float min_x = MIN(MIN(MIN(pos0.x, pos1.x), pos2.x), pos3.x);
1296 float max_x = MAX(MAX(MAX(pos0.x, pos1.x), pos2.x), pos3.x);
1297 float min_y = MIN(MIN(MIN(pos0.y, pos1.y), pos2.y), pos3.y);
1298 float max_y = MAX(MAX(MAX(pos0.y, pos1.y), pos2.y), pos3.y);
1299
1300 if (MOUSE_X >= min_x && MOUSE_X <= max_x && MOUSE_Y >= min_y && MOUSE_Y <= max_y)
1301 {
1302
1303 TB_GPU[tb_count].hovered = 1;
1304 tb->hovered = true;
1305 }
1306 else
1307 {
1308
1309 tb->hovered = false;
1310 TB_GPU[tb_count].hovered = 0;
1311
1312 }
1313
1314 TB_GPU[tb_count].shadow = tb->shadow;
1315 TB_GPU[tb_count].shadow_dist = tb->shadow_dist;
1316 TB_GPU[tb_count].shadow_dir = tb->shadow_dir;
1317
1318 TB_GPU[tb_count].color = (vec4){0,0,0,0};
1319 TB_GPU[tb_count].fill = (vec4){0,0,0,0};
1320
1321 TB_GPU[tb_count].visible = visible;
1322 TB_GPU[tb_count].model = mat;
1323 if (tb->uID == EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_text_id && tb->menu == EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_ui_menu_id)
1324 {
1325 TB_GPU[tb_count].state = UISTATE_SELECTED;
1326 }
1327 else
1328 {
1329 TB_GPU[tb_count].state = tb->state;
1330 }
1331 (*TC)++;
1332}

1361void GPU_upload_singular_element(UIContainer * cs, UIElement * el, int * ui_el_count, int * el_count)
1362{
1363 int ec = *el_count;
1364
1365 float scale_x = (float)TEXT_WIDTH / UI_SCALE_WIDTH;
1366 float scale_y = (float)TEXT_HEIGHT / UI_SCALE_HEIGHT;
1367 float screen_scale_x = (float)SCREEN_WIDTH / UI_SCALE_WIDTH;
1368 float screen_scale_y = (float)SCREEN_HEIGHT / UI_SCALE_HEIGHT;
1369 vec2 text_tr = el->translation;
1370 text_tr.x *= scale_x;
1371 text_tr.y *= scale_y;
1372 vec2 scale = el->scale;
1373 mat4 mat = compose_2d_transform(text_tr, el->angle, scale);
1374 uint32_t visible = el->visible;
1375
1376 float scale_screen = compute_ui_scale(UI_SCALE_WIDTH, UI_SCALE_HEIGHT, SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT);
1377 vec2 tr = el->translation;
1378 tr.x *= screen_scale_x;
1379 tr.y *= screen_scale_y;
1380 vec2 tr_scale = el->scale;
1381 tr_scale.x *= screen_scale_x;
1382 tr_scale.y *= screen_scale_y;
1383 mat4 mat_screen = compose_2d_transform(tr, el->angle, tr_scale);
1384 uint32_t hovered = 0;
1385 vec2 local = vec2_sub((vec2){MOUSE_X, MOUSE_Y}, text_tr);
1386 local.x *= 1.0f/el->scale.x;
1387 local.y *= 1.0f/el->scale.y;
1388
1389 if (el->uID == EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_ui_element_id && el->menu == EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_ui_menu_id)
1390 {
1391 UI_GPU[ec].state = UISTATE_SELECTED;
1392 }
1393 else
1394 {
1395 UI_GPU[ec].state = el->state;
1396 }
1397 UI_GPU[ec].shadow = el->shadow;
1398 UI_GPU[ec].shadow_dist = el->shadow_dist;
1399 UI_GPU[ec].shadow_dir = el->shadow_dir;
1400 UI_GPU[ec].color = el->color;
1401 UI_GPU[ec].fill = el->fill;
1402 UI_GPU[ec].visible = visible;
1403 UI_GPU[ec].model = mat;
1404 UI_GPU[ec].pos = el->center;
1405 UI_GPU[ec].type = el->type;
1406 UI_GPU[ec].size = el->size;
1407 UI_GPU[ec].radius = el->radius;
1408 UI_GPU[ec].translation = el->translation;
1409 UI_GPU[ec].scale = el->scale;
1410 if (container_is_valid(el->parent_container, el->menu))
1411 {
1412 UIContainer * c = &cs[el->parent_container];
1413 UI_GPU[ec].masked = c->mask;
1414 }
1415 else
1416 {
1417 UI_GPU[ec].masked = false;
1418 }
1419 if (container_is_valid(el->container, el->menu))
1420 {
1421 UIContainer * c = &cs[el->container];
1422 UI_GPU[ec].padding = c->padding;
1423 }
1424
1425 UI_UIDS[ui_element_count].uid = *el_count;
1426 UI_UIDS[ui_element_count].layer = el->layer;
1427
1428 ui_element_count++;
1429 (*el_count)++;
1430}

1463void GPU_upload_ui_elements()
1464{
1465
1466 UIMenu * ms = CAST_VEC(MENUS, UIMenu);
1467 int el_count = 0;
1468 int tb_count = 0;
1469
1470 size_t container_count = 0;
1471 for (int i = 0; i < MENUS.count; i++)
1472 {
1473 for (int j = 0; j < MAX_UI_CONTAINERS; j++)
1474 {
1475
1476 if (ms[i].containers[j].free) continue;
1477 container_count++;
1478 }
1479 }
1480
1481 if (container_ids_cap < container_count)
1482 {
1483 int * new_cids = realloc(container_ids, sizeof(UIContainer) * container_count);
1484 container_ids_cap = container_count;
1485 if (new_cids)
1486 {
1487 container_ids = new_cids;
1488 }
1489 else
1490 {
1491 printf("Malloc Failed UI Ele\n");
1492 free(container_ids);
1493 container_ids = NULL;
1494 return;
1495 }
1496 }
1497 for (int i = 0; i < container_ids_cap; i++)
1498 {
1499 container_ids[i] = -1;
1500 }
1501
1502
1503 size_t offset = 0;
1504 ui_element_count = 0;
1505 for (int i = 0; i < MENUS.count; i++)
1506 {
1507
1508 if (!EDITOR_SETTINGS.UI && i != PERFORMANCE_OVERLAY_MENU) continue;
1509
1510 UIElement * els = ms[i].elements;
1511 TextBox * tbs = ms[i].text_boxes;
1512 UIContainer * cs = ms[i].containers;
1513 for (int j = 0; j < MAX_UI_ELEMENTS; j++)
1514 {
1515
1516 UIElement * el = &els[j];
1517 if (el->free) continue;
1518
1519 upload_parent_container(el, cs, els, &el_count, offset);
1520 if (container_is_valid(el->parent_container, el->menu))
1521 {
1522 UI_GPU[el_count].container_id = container_ids[el->parent_container + offset];
1523 }
1524 else
1525 {
1526 UI_GPU[el_count].container_id = -1;
1527 }
1528 GPU_upload_singular_element(cs, el, &ui_element_count, &el_count);
1529 }
1530
1531 for (int j = 0; j < MAX_UI_ELEMENTS; j++)
1532 {
1533
1534 TextBox * tb = &tbs[j];
1535 if (tb->free) continue;
1536
1537 TB_GPU[tb_count].mask = 0;
1538 if (container_is_valid(tb->parent_container, tb->menu))
1539 {
1540 TB_GPU[tb_count].container_id = container_ids[tb->parent_container + offset];
1541 if (cs[tb->parent_container].mask)
1542 {
1543 TB_GPU[tb_count].mask = 1;
1544 }
1545 }
1546 else
1547 {
1548 TB_GPU[tb_count].container_id = -1;
1549 }
1550 GPU_upload_singular_text_box(cs, tb, &tb_count);
1551 }
1552
1553 for (int j = 0; j < MAX_UI_CONTAINERS; j++)
1554 {
1555 if (ms[i].containers[j].free) continue;
1556 offset++;
1557 }
1558
1559 }
1560
1561 qsort(UI_UIDS, ui_element_count, sizeof(UIUIDPair), compare_uid_pair);
1562 for (int i = 0; i < ui_element_count; i++)
1563 {
1564 UI_UID_OUT[i] = UI_UIDS[i].uid;
1565 }
1566
1567 size_t text_box_ssbo_offset = current_frame * text_box_ssbo_size;
1568 uint32_t * text_box_ssbo_data = (uint32_t*)(text_box_ssbo_ptr + text_box_ssbo_offset);
1569 memcpy(text_box_ssbo_data, TB_GPU, sizeof(TextBoxGPU) * tb_count);
1570 glBindBufferRange(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER, 8, TEXT_BOX_SSBO, text_box_ssbo_offset, text_box_ssbo_size);
1571
1572 size_t ui_ssbo_offset = current_frame * ui_ssbo_size;
1573 uint8_t * ui_ssbo_data = (uint8_t*)(ui_ssbo_ptr + ui_ssbo_offset);
1574 memcpy(ui_ssbo_data, UI_GPU, sizeof(UIElementGPU) * el_count);
1575 glBindBufferRange(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER, 9, UI_SSBO, ui_ssbo_offset, ui_ssbo_size);
1576
1577 size_t ui_instance_vbo_offset = current_frame * ui_instance_vbo_size;
1578 uint32_t * ui_instance_vbo_data = (uint32_t*)(ui_instance_vbo_ptr + ui_instance_vbo_offset);
1579 memcpy(ui_instance_vbo_data, UI_UID_OUT, sizeof(uint32_t) * ui_element_count);
1580
1581
1582
1583}

1863void write_point_light_shadows()
1864{
1865 Light * lights = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.lights, Light);
1866 MeshNode * mns = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.mesh_nodes, MeshNode);
1867 Mesh * meshes = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.meshes, Mesh);
1868
1869 float yaws[6] = {0, M_PI, M_PI, M_PI, M_PI / 2.0f + M_PI, M_PI / 2.0f};
1870 float pitches[6] = {0, 0, M_PI / 2.0f, -M_PI / 2.0f, 0, 0};
1871 vec3 flips[6];
1872 flips[0] = (vec3){0, 0, -1};
1873 flips[1] = (vec3){0, 0, -1};
1874 flips[2] = (vec3){0, -1, 0};
1875 flips[3] = (vec3){0, 1, 0};
1876 flips[4] = (vec3){0, 0, -1};
1877 flips[5] = (vec3){0, 0, -1};
1878
1879 glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
1880 glDepthMask(GL_TRUE);
1881 glDepthFunc(GL_LEQUAL);
1882 glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_FBO.fbo);
1883 glViewport(0, 0, POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_FBO.w, POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_FBO.h);
1884 glFramebufferTexture3D(
1885 GL_FRAMEBUFFER,
1886 GL_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT,
1887 GL_TEXTURE_CUBE_MAP_ARRAY,
1888 POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_FBO.depth_texture.i,
1889 0,
1890 0
1891 );
1892 mat4 proj = make_projection(90, 1, 0.05f, 100.0f);
1893 for (int i = 0; i < GLOBALS.lights.count; i++)
1894 {
1895
1896 Light * l = &lights[i];
1897
1898 if (l->light_type != POINT_LIGHT || master_frame % 2 == 0) continue;
1899
1900 glUseProgram(CULL_POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_SHADER.program);
1901
1902 glBindBufferBase(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER, 5, INDIRECT_ARRAYS_COMMAND_BUFFER);
1903 glBindBufferBase(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER, 6, INDIRECT_ELEMENTS_COMMAND_BUFFER);
1904
1905 glUniform3f(CULL_POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_SHADER.uniforms[0].location, l->pos.x, l->pos.y, l->pos.z);
1906 glUniform1f(CULL_POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_SHADER.uniforms[1].location, l->radius);
1907 glUniform1ui(CULL_POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_SHADER.uniforms[2].location, transform_count);
1908 glUniform1ui(CULL_POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_SHADER.uniforms[3].location, array_offset);
1909
1910 glDispatchCompute((transform_count+63)/64, 1, 1);
1911
1912 glMemoryBarrier(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BARRIER_BIT | GL_COMMAND_BARRIER_BIT);
1913
1914
1915 if (array_offset > 0)
1916 {
1917
1918 glUseProgram(INDIRECT_PREFIX_SHADER.program);
1919
1920 glBindBufferBase(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER, 6, INDIRECT_ARRAYS_COMMAND_BUFFER_OUT);
1921 glUniform1ui(INDIRECT_PREFIX_SHADER.uniforms[0].location, array_offset);
1922
1923 glDispatchCompute((array_offset+127)/128, 1, 1);
1924 glMemoryBarrier(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BARRIER_BIT | GL_COMMAND_BARRIER_BIT);
1925 }
1926
1927 glBindBufferBase(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER, 5, INDIRECT_ELEMENTS_COMMAND_BUFFER);
1928 glBindBufferBase(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER, 6, INDIRECT_ELEMENTS_COMMAND_BUFFER_OUT);
1929 if (element_offset > 0)
1930 {
1931
1932 glUseProgram(ELEMENTS_PREFIX_SHADER.program);
1933
1934 glUniform1ui(ELEMENTS_PREFIX_SHADER.uniforms[0].location, element_offset);
1935
1936 glDispatchCompute((element_offset+127)/128, 1, 1);
1937 glMemoryBarrier(GL_SHADER_STORAGE_BARRIER_BIT | GL_COMMAND_BARRIER_BIT);
1938 }
1939
1940
1941 float clear_color = 1.0f;
1942 glClearTexSubImage(POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_FBO.depth_texture.i, 0, 0, 0, 6 * i, POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_FBO.w, POINT_LIGHT_SHADOWS_FBO.h, 6, GL_DEPTH_COMPONENT, GL_FLOAT, &clear_color);
1943
1944
1945 mat4 VPs[6];
1946 for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++)
1947 {
1948
1949 vec3 pos = l->pos;
1950 Camera sky_cam;
1951 sky_cam.cam_data.cam_pos = vec3_to_vec4(pos);
1952
1953 sky_cam.yaw = yaws[j];
1954 sky_cam.pitch = pitches[j];
1955
1956 compute_camera_basis(&sky_cam, sky_cam.yaw, sky_cam.pitch, 0, flips[j]);
1957
1958 vec3 target = vec3_add(
1959 pos,
1960 sky_cam.forward
1961 );
1962
1963 mat4 view = make_look_at(
1964 &sky_cam,
1965 pos
1966 );
1967 sky_cam.cam_data.view = view;
1968 sky_cam.cam_data.proj = proj;
1969
1970 mat4 VP = m4_mul(proj, view);
1971 VPs[j] = VP;
1972
1973 }
1974 glBindVertexArray(MAIN_VAO);
1975 glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, MAIN_VBO);
1976 glBindBuffer(GL_ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, MAIN_EBO);
1977 glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, INSTANCE_VBO);
1978 glUseProgram(POINT_LIGHT_SHADOW_SHADER.program);
1979 glUniformMatrix4fv(POINT_LIGHT_SHADOW_SHADER.uniforms[0].location, 6, GL_FALSE, (const GLfloat*)VPs);
1980 glUniform3f(POINT_LIGHT_SHADOW_SHADER.uniforms[1].location, l->pos.x, l->pos.y, l->pos.z);
1981 glUniform1f(POINT_LIGHT_SHADOW_SHADER.uniforms[2].location, 100.0f);
1982 glUniform1ui(POINT_LIGHT_SHADOW_SHADER.uniforms[3].location, 6 * i);
1983
1984 draw_arrays_elements(&POINT_LIGHT_SHADOW_SHADER, 0, 0, array_offset, 0, 0, element_offset);
1985
1986
1987 l->sm_dirty = false;
1988
1989 }
1990 glDisable(GL_CULL_FACE);
1991}

2231void determine_closest_rprobes()
2232{
2233
2234
2235
2236 RPROBE_UBO_DATA.probe_count = 0;
2237 float distances[MAX_RPROBES_PER_FRAME] = {INFINITY};
2238
2239 int num_probes = GLOBALS.scene_data.reflection_probes.count;
2240
2241 ReflectionProbe * rprobes = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.scene_data.reflection_probes, ReflectionProbe);
2242 const float MAX_DIST = 20.0f;
2243 for (int i = 0; i < num_probes; i++)
2244 {
2245 ReflectionProbe * p = &rprobes[i];
2246
2247 float longest = -INFINITY;
2248 int longest_index = 0;
2249 if (RPROBE_UBO_DATA.probe_count < 4)
2250 {
2251 RPROBE_UBO_DATA.probe_indices[RPROBE_UBO_DATA.probe_count++].val = i;
2252 continue;
2253 }
2254
2255 for (int j = 0; j < RPROBE_UBO_DATA.probe_count; j++)
2256 {
2257 if (distances[j] > longest)
2258 {
2259 longest_index = j;
2260 longest = distances[j];
2261 }
2262 }
2263
2264 float current_dist = vec3_length(vec3_sub(CAM_POS, p->aabb.center));
2265 if (current_dist < longest)
2266 {
2267 RPROBE_UBO_DATA.probe_indices[longest_index].val = i;
2268 }
2269
2270
2271 }
2272
2273

2914
2915int find_depth(BVHNode * nodes, BVHNode * node, int depth)
2916{
2917 int l = depth;
2918 if (node->left != -1)
2919 {
2920 l = find_depth(nodes, &nodes[node->left], depth + 1);
2921 }
2922 int r = depth;
2923 if (node->right != -1)
2924 {
2925 r = find_depth(nodes, &nodes[node->right], depth + 1);
2926 }
2927
2928 return MAX(l, r);
2929}
2930
2931void render_tree(BVHNode * nodes, BVHNode * node, mat4 tr, DebugVertex * points, int * count, int depth, int max_depth, vec3 start_color, vec3 end_color)
2932{
2933
2934
2935
2936 if (node->left == -1 && node->right == -1)
2937 {
2938
2939 DebugVertex * v = &points[*count];
2940 AABB a = transform_aabb_by_model_matrix(node->aabb, tr);
2941 aabb_to_vertices(v, &a, (vec3){0,0,0});
2942 for (int j = 0; j < 24; j++)
2943 {
2944 v[j].color = vec3_lerp(start_color, end_color, (float)depth / max_depth);
2945 }
2946 *count += 24;
2947 }
2948
2949 if (node->left != -1)
2950 {
2951 render_tree(nodes, &nodes[node->left], tr, points, count, depth + 1, max_depth, start_color, end_color);
2952 }
2953 if (node->right != -1)
2954 {
2955 render_tree(nodes, &nodes[node->right], tr, points, count, depth + 1, max_depth, start_color, end_color);
2956 }
2957
2958}

2961{

2964
2965

2967 int count = 0;

2979void render_probe_volume(ProbeVolume * pv, bool audio)
2980{
2981
2982 OBB obb = pv->obb;
2983 obb_to_vertices(&DEBUG_LINES[DEBUG_LINE_COUNT], &obb);
2984 for (int j = 0; j < 24; j++)
2985 {
2986 DEBUG_LINES[DEBUG_LINE_COUNT + j].color = (vec3){0,0,1};
2987 }
2988 DEBUG_LINE_COUNT += 24;
2989 if ((EDITOR_SETTINGS.audio_probe_volume_overlay && audio) || (EDITOR_SETTINGS.lighting_probe_volume_overlay && (!audio)))
2990 {
2991 float dx = (obb.extents.x * 2) / (pv->resolution.x-1);
2992 float dy = (obb.extents.y * 2) / (pv->resolution.y-1);
2993 float dz = (obb.extents.z * 2) / (pv->resolution.z-1);
2994
2995 vec3 fwd = {obb.rot.a0, obb.rot.b0, obb.rot.c0};
2996 vec3 right = {obb.rot.a1, obb.rot.b1, obb.rot.c1};
2997 vec3 up = {obb.rot.a2, obb.rot.b2, obb.rot.c2};
2998
2999 vec3 step_x, step_y, step_z;
3000 step_x.x = fwd.x * dx;
3001 step_x.y = fwd.y * dx;
3002 step_x.z = fwd.z * dx;
3003
3004 step_y.x = right.x * dy;
3005 step_y.y = right.y * dy;
3006 step_y.z = right.z * dy;
3007
3008 step_z.x = up.x * dz;
3009 step_z.y = up.y * dz;
3010 step_z.z = up.z * dz;
3011
3012 vec3 pos = vec3_add(obb.center,
3013 vec3_add(vec3_scale(fwd, -obb.extents.x),
3014 vec3_add(vec3_scale(right, -obb.extents.y),
3015 vec3_scale(up, -obb.extents.z))));
3016
3017 vec3 current_pos = pos;
3018 for (int z = 0; z < pv->resolution.z; z++)
3019 {
3020 for (int y = 0; y < pv->resolution.y; y++)
3021 {
3022
3023 for (int x = 0; x < pv->resolution.x; x++)
3024 {
3025
3026 int index = z * pv->resolution.y * pv->resolution.x + y * pv->resolution.x + x;
3027 vec3 color = {0.3, 0.3, 0};
3028 if (index == DEBUG_CURRENT_APROBE)
3029 {
3030 color = (vec3){1,1,1};
3031 }
3032 if (index == 0)
3033 {
3034 color = (vec3){1,0,0};
3035 }
3036 current_pos.x = pos.x + x * step_x.x + y * step_y.x + z * step_z.x;
3037 current_pos.y = pos.y + x * step_x.y + y * step_y.y + z * step_z.y;
3038 current_pos.z = pos.z + x * step_x.z + y * step_y.z + z * step_z.z;
3039 AABB aabb;
3040 aabb.center = current_pos;
3041 aabb.extents = (vec3){EDITOR_APROBE_SIZE, EDITOR_APROBE_SIZE, EDITOR_APROBE_SIZE};
3042 if (DEBUG_LINE_COUNT + 24 >= DEBUG_LINES_MAX) break;
3043 aabb_to_vertices(&DEBUG_LINES[DEBUG_LINE_COUNT], &aabb, (vec3){0,0,0});
3044 for (int j = 0; j < 24; j++)
3045 {
3046
3047 DEBUG_LINES[DEBUG_LINE_COUNT + j].color = color;
3048 }
3049 DEBUG_LINE_COUNT += 24;
3050 }
3051 }
3052 }
3053 }
3054}
